title: Turn Map Listings into Booked Discovery Calls
summary: Pull local businesses from the map, audit their sites, enrich the contacts and book calls with the ones that need help.

money_potential.label: High
money_potential.basis: Assumes you sell builds or monthly retainers, so each client who signs adds recurring income.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Each booked call is a shot at a website, SEO or care-plan client.
Audits make the first message specific instead of generic.
who_its_for: Freelance web and SEO providers who sell to local businesses.

steps.name: Maps Lead List Builder
steps.does: Pulls local businesses into a sheet

steps: Pick one niche and one city.
Run the map pull and audits, then shortlist ten businesses by hand.
Have Site Research brief the shortlist and enrich the contacts.
Send the meeting requests yourself after editing.
guardrails: Every message and document stays a draft until you approve it.
Check local rules on cold outreach, calls and texts before contacting anyone.
